author: Haroen Viaene
subject: fix(server): error when multiple InstantSearch instances in getServerState (#5588)
bodyLines: In server environments, the InstantSearch instance gets passed from InstantSearchSSRProvider to InstantSearch, meaning that all child InstantSearch components have the _same_ instance, which can cause many issues.
As this already is working badly, I don't think erroring would be a breaking change, but possibly people are already relying on the current behaviour?
